item.title: Apple Keeps Hide My Email on @icloud.com After Reversal
item.description: Apple reverses its plan to move Hide My Email to @private.icloud.com, keeping disposable addresses on @icloud.com after user backlash and staff.

item.title: iOS 27 Unlocks AI Home Perks for iCloud+ Subscribers
item.description: Apple’s iOS 27 introduces AI-driven Home app features for iCloud+ 2TB+ subscribers, including video summaries and smart clip search.

item.title: Apple’s Siri AI Upgrade May Introduce iCloud+ Paywall
item.description: Apple hints at a paywall for Siri AI users, using iCloud+ subscriptions while licensing Google’s Gemini model amid AI‑driven hardware cost hikes.
